runs.scenario: If UKMTO reports an explosion five nautical miles from a merchant vessel, with no damage and no indication the vessel was targeted, one reader could count it as close to the vessel while another could find it too distant. The criterion gives no distance threshold for 'close.'
runs.yes_requires: At least one merchant vessel in the Strait of Hormuz, Persian Gulf, Gulf of Oman or Arabian Sea (including waters around Socotra) must be involved in a qualifying incident on 28 November 2026 Gulf Standard Time (UTC+4): an attack, explosion, mine strike, projectile or drone hit, armed craft firing on or attempting to board it, boarding, hijacking or seizure.
